data.content_ref: inline:SRC_007 (claiming $909) depends on a premium-only decomposition: base-for-all (47×$18=$846) plus overtime premium (7×$9=$63). This reduces to the calculation 47×18 + 7×9 = 909, which structurally differs from the standard method (40×18 + 7×27 = 855) by overcounting base pay for overtime hours. It is refuted if the standard piecewise method (paying overtime hours at 1.5× the base rate instead of stacking a half-time premium on already-paid base hours) is the correct interpretation of the overtime rule.
